name: HSE — what is involved in an autism assessment
description: HSE public guidance describing what an autism assessment for a child or adult may involve and the possible assessment-report outcomes.
intended_use: Use for process expectations without treating a checklist, questionnaire or ND Oracle interaction as diagnostic proof.
audience_or_context: Children and adults in the Republic of Ireland who are preparing for or considering an autism assessment.
limitations: The page describes assessment content and outcomes; it does not create a referral entitlement or determine whether a particular person is autistic.
The exact professionals and process can vary with age, complexity and service context.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE publishes the guidance; ND Oracle uses it for process context without converting it into a personalised diagnosis.

provenance.method: HSE autism-assessment process page checked on 2026-09-04 for developmental-history, broader-information and report-outcome context. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
